name: How long do restored surfaces typically last?

mainEntity.name: How long do restored surfaces typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of restored surfaces depends on several factors, including the type of material, the restoration methods used, the quality of maintenance, and environmental exposure. Generally, a well-executed surface restoration can last for many years, often 5-15 years or more, with proper care. We use durable materials and proven techniques to ensure the longest possible lifespan for your restored surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restored surfaces can last 5-15+ years with proper care, depending on material, methods, and maintenance.
